First, reputation decay blocks fakes. Start 100 points. Idle 2 epochs, then lose 8 per epoch. Below 60, rewards stop. An island of idle clones can't wait.
Then, verified work adds 6 points per task, cap 100. A delta of 8 per idle epoch forces each clone to work each epoch. Copied answers cut the score to 20, freeze rewards 6 epochs.
Finally, the cost: 1,000 clones above 60 take 3,000 units of work per epoch. The umber market for fakes dies fast.
